preferSdk.description: When true, attempts to use the SDK when running tests in singleplayer mode. Must also include 'sdkPath'.

sdkPath.description: Absolute path to the root folder of the U3-SDK.

serverId.description: Server ID or singleplayer world name to use for tests. Defaults to 'uTest'. Must be a valid folder name.

maxTestVariations.description: Maximum number of variations a test can have before the calculation short-circuits. It is very easy to accidentally define a test that has millions of variations so this limit is important. Defaults to 65535.
